name: Fax
description: Radiofax receiver and sender: WEFAX weather charts (IOC 576/288, the 1500/2300 Hz FM subcarrier at 120 LPM), Group 1 analog phone fax (ITU T.2 — the pre-modem office machine at 1300/2100 Hz, 180 LPM), and a wideband wire preset. Quadrature FM discriminator, start/stop tone automation, slant and phase trims, scrolling paper with PNG save, test-page TX and a pure-math self-test.
author: Ham Radio Web Studio
